sources: ontology/spec/upstream/bundle (Argo CD v3.6.1, Flux helm v1.7.1, kustomize v1.10.1 CRDs)
scenario: the fix of checkout's PAYMENT_TIMEOUT was merged in Git; the Application's sync of that revision fails on an invalid Ingress of the same revision, so the live ConfigMap keeps 30x
query: why is checkout still failing after the fix was merged in shop
mechanism: its last sync of the Git revision with the fix failed on an invalid Ingress; the ConfigMap with the bad value, written 26 h ago, stays live
pass_if: names the Application's failed sync as why the fix is not live
partial_if_only: checkout crashes on its PAYMENT_TIMEOUT value, without the failed sync
chain: ConfigMap/shop/checkout-config holds 30x, last written by argocd-controller 26 h ago, OutOfSync
Application/argocd/checkout's last sync of the new revision failed on Ingress checkout

decoys.why_not: holds the bad value but is the old revision's, not the cause of it staying
